title: Intune Custom Compliance & Configuration Items (Scripted)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (custom compliance policies with detection scripts + scripted configuration items/settings in Intune; conditional logic, JSON discovery rules).
Distinct from device-compliance-policies (standard built-in compliance); this is the SCRIPTED custom-compliance + configuration-items angle. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Enforce the checks Intune's built-in settings can't — with scripted custom compliance and config items
problem: Intune's built-in compliance settings cover the basics, but real requirements go further: a registry value, a specific app version, a security control the GUI can't reach. The answer is custom compliance — a PowerShell detection script plus a JSON rule that Intune evaluates — and scripted configuration items for settings outside the templates. This solution gives you a repeatable way to author, deploy, and manage custom compliance and configuration items in Intune, so device state is measured and enforced exactly the way your standards require.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Intune custom compliance works (the detection script + JSON discovery rule + settings mapping), scripted configuration items / settings-catalog custom settings, how custom compliance feeds Conditional Access, and the authoring model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, PowerShell script signing/execution, a compliance baseline, target groups, Conditional Access) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: write the detection script, author the JSON rule and settings mapping, upload as a custom compliance policy, add scripted configuration items, assign to a pilot, validate evaluation and Conditional Access effect, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — a custom-compliance detection-script template, a rule/JSON validation script, a fleet custom-compliance report, safe remediation of non-compliant devices, and a compliance-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to author, deploy, and manage custom compliance and configuration items in Intune — PowerShell detection scripts + JSON rules and scripted config items for the checks the built-in settings can't reach. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable way to author, deploy, and manage custom compliance and configuration items in Intune — PowerShell detection scripts plus JSON rules and scripted config items for checks the built-in settings can't reach.
meta_description: Author scripted custom compliance in Intune: PowerShell detection scripts + JSON discovery rules and scripted configuration items for checks beyond the built-in settings, feeding Conditional Access. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Device state measured and enforced exactly to your standards — custom compliance detection scripts and scripted configuration items covering what the built-in settings can't, wired into Conditional Access — proven on a pilot before you scale.
